generation.scope: With no Klein grading imposed, the singly symmetric rank-ten locus is smooth at the rational regular sample and has a fourteen-dimensional unmarked family, geometrically generically AS, with trivial projective indexed stabilizer and minimal period four. At this and the rank-sixteen sample the unrestricted normal tangents have dimensions (5,2,4,4) by character and all primary obstructions vanish. The extra alternating direction maps the opposite kernel isomorphically to its cokernel.

proof_review.scope: Verified Schur derivatives in both cuts, orbit-normal dimensions, smoothness of the even locus, specialization of finite stabilizers, second-order lifting and degreewise flatness over Artinian bases.

mathematical_computation.scope: Exact rational Jacobians, orbit inclusion and rank, polarized pairwise obstruction image tests and opposite-kernel compression.

open_mathematics: Compute higher obstructions or algebraize the fifteen unrestricted directions at the rational maximal-rank point. Complete the double-zero determinant fibers on the marked chart and analyze singular cross blocks.
